rule.USD: USD = round(EUR × 1.10 to the nearest cent). Rate 1.10 is a fixed website rate set on 22 Nov 2026 from a mid-market rate of about 1.097.
rule.ZAR: ZAR fallback: ZAR = (integer part of EUR × 19.25) + 0.99, a .99 charm price at or above the converted amount. Rate 19.25 is a fixed website rate set on 22 Nov 2026 from a mid-market rate of about 19.24–19.27.
